take_homes: What I tell the model earlier (my role, facts, preferences) changes everything it writes afterwards. I can use that for HR work.
An agent's review of its own work is too kind. I should trust my own read first and get a fresh, independent reader.
Lessons go into a rules file that a colleague's agent can reuse. That is how a good habit could spread through a team.
